reason: It's free and the coupon-with-PIN counter is exactly what I didn't have when I paid a creator and got likes but no customers. I'll have my marketing person list one offer and see if the redemptions are real, but I'm not paying anyone or spending staff time beyond that until I see numbers.
objection: It's a beta with a small team. Will any good creators near my outlets actually be on it, or will I just get people with bought followers asking for free food?
would_change_my_mind: If after the first month no decent local creators show interest, or the coupons barely get redeemed, I'll drop it. Seeing two or three real creators with solid average views in my area would keep me on.
